review_evidence: HexBareiss/Bareiss.lean defines BareissData and BareissState, determinant/sign extraction, pivot search, exact-division interfaces, elimination loops, and proves pivot-search and state facts.
HexBareiss/BorderedMinor.lean defines borderedMinor and proves entry formulas and principal-submatrix identities needed by determinant arguments.
The root module documents the library as the executable Bareiss determinant algorithm with bordered-minor correctness support, not an import-only wrapper over external results.
summary: Retain hex-bareiss as a substantive executable and proved development of fraction-free Bareiss determinant elimination and bordered-minor infrastructure.

review_evidence: HexBareiss.lean (702 bytes, read in full): `module`, `public import` of HexBareiss.BorderedMinor, HexBareiss.Bareiss, HexBareiss.Kernel, a `public section` command, and a module docstring describing the Bareiss determinant library; no declarations of its own, but the `public section` command takes it outside the FILTER-007 pure-import class.

HexBareiss/Kernel.lean: module docstring explains a determinant certificate (row swaps, lower triangular transform L, check (prod l_i) * d = sign sigma * prod u_i, singular case via left kernel vector) and states that the soundness theorem det_eq_of_checkList lives in HexBareissMathlib.

HexBareiss/Kernel.lean declares inductive DetWitness and definitions value, swapRows, applySwaps, signOf, dotInt, columns, triangularCheck, scaledRows, checkDetList, checkDetRat, rowLists, detWitnessOfLists, detWitness, plus private Elim/findPivot/step/assemble for the fraction-free elimination on [A | I].
HexBareiss/Kernel.lean ends with #guard checks computing determinant witnesses for a 3x3 pivoting example (value -32), a singular 3x3 example (value 0), and a rational-scaled checkDetRat case.
summary: Read HexBareiss.lean in full and inspected HexBareiss/Kernel.lean declarations, module docstring, and #guard checks. Kernel.lean defines the kernel-checkable integer determinant certificate (DetWitness, checkDetList, checkDetRat, triangularCheck) and its fraction-free Bareiss-style producer (detWitness), which is searchable formal mathematics infrastructure. HexBareiss.lean is not a pure import aggregator under FILTER-007: besides three public imports it has a `module` header, a `public section` command, and a library docstring. Both files are retained.
